comment: English mirror of messages-ar.json. Keys must stay identical; the assistant answers in Arabic, this file covers interface labels and the English localization target.
disclaimer: This information is for awareness only and is not a substitute for consulting a doctor or pharmacist. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using any medicine or changing treatment.
pageSubtitle: Questions about medicines and health, answered from the app's own database — on your device, offline.

state.notDownloaded: The model is not on this device yet
state.loading: Loading the model onto the device
state.unsupported: This device cannot run the model

download.title: Download the model once
download.body: A small model that runs inside your device with no internet. Download one {size} file once, and every question after that is answered locally.
download.wifiBody: The file is {size}. On mobile data it can consume most of your bundle.
download.storageBody: It needs {required} of free space on the device.
download.privacyBody: The download happens once from a pre-set official link. After that your questions are processed on the device and nothing is sent anywhere.
download.cancelConfirm: Download cancelled and the partial file was removed.
download.importBody: If this device has no internet: download the file as {fileName} on a computer or memory stick, then choose Import from device.
download.importPickFailed: The file picker is not available on this platform.
download.importFailed: Import failed. Check that the file is named {fileName} and is {size}.
download.checksumFailed: The downloaded file does not match the original copy, so it was deleted. Try downloading again.
download.failedNetwork: Download failed: no internet connection or the link is unavailable.
download.failedDisk: Download failed: not enough free space.
download.deleteConfirm: The model will be removed and you will have to download it again. Confirm removal.
download.cachedNote: The model lives in the app's private storage and will not be downloaded again unless you delete it or a new version is configured.

load.memoryLow: Free memory is low; the model should not run right now. Close other apps and try again.
load.loadingHint: The first load takes a few seconds on a weak device.
load.failed: The model could not be started on this device.
load.unloaded: The model was released from memory to save resources.

capability.why: Running the model needs at least {minRam}. This device reports {ram}.
capability.ramUnknown: The exact memory size could not be read; performance may be poor.

answer.sourcesNone: No product-specific source record was used for this response.
answer.databaseSource: Data source: the app database (version {version}, dated {date})
answer.conflictNote: The Egyptian data and an international source differ; the Egyptian figures are shown first.
answer.docCardLabel: Reference card from the trusted sources
answer.smartSearchBody: No on-device model is available. These are matching product/reference records, not a single clinical answer. Brand names may cover different ingredients and strengths: pick the exact product and verify its current label. Prices are saved database values, not live quotes.
answer.highRiskBody: These are matching records, not a single clinical answer. This question touches pregnancy, breastfeeding, interactions, kidney or liver disease, children or a dose, so no generated summary is shown. Read the records and the official sources, use the matching tool in the menu, and confirm with a pharmacist or doctor.

refusal.offTopic: I cannot help with that one - medicines and health are my specialty. Ask me about a medicine, an ingredient, a symptom or a lab test and I am all ears.
refusal.clarify: I am not sure your question is a health one. Can you say exactly what you are asking about — a medicine, a symptom or a test?
refusal.clarifyAgain: It is still unclear whether the question is health related. Ask about a medicine, an active ingredient or a lab test and I will answer from the database.
refusal.sanitizeTooLong: That question is too long. Keep it under {max} characters and I will answer.
refusal.sanitizeRejected: I could not process that request. Ask a direct health question about a medicine, a symptom or a test.

conversation.comment: Fixed replies for a greeting, thanks, goodbye or a question about the assistant itself, used when the device has no on-device model to phrase them. The chat guard rejects a model reply that carries a number, a medicine name or medical advice, and this is what the reader gets instead.
conversation.greeting: Hello! I am the Drugcopeia assistant. What would you like to ask about today?
conversation.thanks: You are welcome. I am here whenever you want to ask about a medicine or a symptom.
conversation.farewell: Goodbye, and take care. Ask me whenever you need a medicine checked.
conversation.smallTalk: I am the Drugcopeia assistant. I help with Egyptian medicines - their ingredients, the dose printed on the pack, side effects, interactions and prices - and with general information about symptoms and conditions. What would you like to ask?

emergency.title: This is an emergency
emergency.body: The symptoms you describe can be dangerous and need immediate medical care. Call the ambulance on {phone} now, or go to the nearest emergency department.
emergency.noWait: Do not wait for another answer before contacting the ambulance.
pillars: Go to the nearest emergency room
Take the medicine packs you use with you

noData.title: Not enough data
noData.body: No matching record was found in the database or in the documents stored on this device, and I will not guess. Try the trade name or the active ingredient, or read about it on an international reference site:
noData.tryNames: Type the trade name in English or Arabic, the company, or the active ingredient.
noData.doctorNote: Those sites give general information only. A diagnosis and a treatment plan need a doctor.
noData.highRiskBody: No source in this app supports an answer to this question, so I will not write one from general knowledge. Pregnancy, breastfeeding, interactions, kidney or liver disease, children and dose questions need a checked source. Use the official sources below, the interaction checker, the pregnancy list or the pediatric calculator in the menu, and confirm with a pharmacist or doctor.

general.label: General information
general.note: The database on this device has no record of it, so this is general knowledge from the model and it deliberately gives no dose. The exact dose is on the pack or at the pharmacist's.
general.verify: Check it against one of the sites above before acting on it, and ask a doctor about your own case.

guard.fallbackTitle: The answer is shown as a data card
guard.fallbackBody: The generated summary was rejected because it contained something that is not in the reference data. The approved data below is copied straight from the database:
guard.reasonFabricated: A number or medicine name in the answer is not present in the retrieved records.
guard.reasonDose: The answer contains a personalized dose.
guard.reasonStop: The answer tells the user to stop or change prescribed treatment.
guard.reasonLanguage: The answer is not in Arabic.
guard.reasonOffTopic: The answer left the health topic.

errors.generic: I could not complete this request. Try again.
errors.timeout: The model took longer than allowed. Try again or shorten the question.
errors.bridgeMissing: The model runtime is not available in this build; the assistant works in smart-search mode until it is enabled.
errors.configMissing: The assistant configuration files are incomplete; move to a newer build of the app.
errors.modelMissing: The model is not downloaded. Start the download or import the file first.
errors.generationFailed: Generation failed; the database card is shown instead.

settings.title: Assistant settings
settings.autoDownloadHint: Generation happens on the device; questions are never sent to a server.

ui.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
ui.sessionSaved: The chat is stored on your device only.

photo.reading: Reading the photograph on this device
photo.barcode: Read the barcode {code} and matched it to {name}
photo.text: Read the printed name {name} off the pack
photo.noMatch: The pack was read but nothing matched a medicine in the directory
photo.nothing: No barcode or readable text was found in the photograph
photo.unsupported: This device cannot read photographs. Type the name instead
photo.failed: The photograph could not be read. Try another picture or type the name
photo.permission: Camera access is needed to take the picture
photo.notImage: That file is not a picture

chat.preparing: Preparing the medicine index on this device…
chat.preparingHint: This happens once per launch and takes a few seconds.
chat.deleteModel: Delete the model from this device
chat.deleteModelDone: The model was deleted. You can download it again at any time.
chat.historySaved: The conversation is saved encrypted on this device.
chat.newChatDone: A new conversation started; the previous one is kept in Privacy.
chat.cardFallback: The generated text was rejected because it left the trusted records. This is the database card instead.
chat.downloadPaused: The download is paused. You can resume from the same point.
chat.downloadReady: The model is ready on this device.
